course.name: Owls Options Traders
course.tagline: Options alerts and education community covering options, stocks and crypto, with three analysts posting live trade ideas and daily watchlists.
course.about: Owls Options Traders is a Discord-based alerts and education community covering options, common stock and crypto trading. Members get live trade alerts and technical analysis from three in-house analysts, daily watchlists with key support/resistance levels, options-flow and dark-pool scanning tools, and training materials aimed at beginners through to more experienced traders.

curriculum.title: Training materials
topics: Day trading, scalping and swing strategies
Reading options flow and dark-pool activity
Technical analysis and key support/resistance levels

pricing.name: Free (3-day trial)
pricing.billing_note: Full Discord access, daily technical alerts, options and day trades/scalps/swings, common stock purchases, unusual options flow software, and the key-levels watchlist — for 3 days.

pricing.name: Pro (Monthly)
pricing.billing_note: Full Discord access, premium chat group, key levels and daily watchlist, live chat and pre/post-market analysis, training courses and materials, options flow and AI bots, credit/debit spreads.

pricing.name: Lifetime
pricing.billing_note: One-time payment for lifetime access to the Pro tier.

course.refund_policy: No refunds. Cancellation/downgrade is handled inside Discord (the provider's FAQ points members to the disclaimer channel, or typing "Downgrade" in the upgrade channel).
course.testimonials_note: Every testimonial we found on the provider's own site states a specific profit or account-growth figure. We don't republish testimonials that promise or imply trading results, so none are shown here.

_notes.source: owlsoptionstraders.com (about, formats, FAQ/refund policy, testimonials — all excluded for income claims) and its Shopify CDN for the full-resolution logo.
